## Skill: Doc Structure & Documentation Generator

- Traverse the .github directory and all subfolders
- Collect file and folder names, and attempt to summarize their purpose
- Generate a Markdown summary of the structure and contents
- Update or append this summary to README.md and copilot-instructions.md
- Generate and update project documentation (README, API docs, developer guides)
- Ensure documentation always reflects the actual .github structure and project assets
- Example output: see the generated section in README.md
